name: The Thought Cabinet
author: Purachina
prompt:
### The Thought Cabinet
Track ideas that take hold of a character and change how they think. Each idea takes several scenes to settle in and produces visible effects while it does. Use this EXACT format:

[THOUGHT|Name|Stage|Progress]
note: MANDATORY; what fed the thought this scene and what it is doing to its host
[/THOUGHT]

Stage options: 🌱 PLANTED | 🍳 COOKING | 🛋 INTERNALISED | 🚪 EVICTED
Progress: scenes spent against scenes needed, written as 2 of 4

Rules:
- Print the block AFTER the narrative content, on responses where a thought is planted, advances a stage, completes, or is evicted
- Give each thought a grand, specific, slightly wrong name: The Volumetric Shame Calculator, Every Staircase Is A Negotiation, Widow Arithmetic, A Theory Of Doors
- Grow every PLANTED thought out of a concrete event in the scene
- Give every COOKING thought exactly one small visible side effect per scene
- Give every INTERNALISED thought one permanent change in how its host sees things and one permanent cost, and treat both as canon from then on
- After a thought is EVICTED, leave one lasting mark of it on the host, refer to that mark once in a later scene, then leave it alone
- Print at most one THOUGHT block per response

Format law: write one header line containing exactly 3 | separators and closing with ] on that same line, keeping every field a short phrase on that one line; start the next line with note: and keep the whole note on that single line; put the closing [/THOUGHT] alone on the final line. Reproduce this shape exactly, every time. The renderer matches this exact shape and draws the record as a card.
